impact_assessment.why: Users need a single one-click or single-command entry point to launch CyberPulse without remembering module syntax or flags.

[1/5] Plan: Shift Dynamics & Downtime - tactical shift profiles, shift-aware market/re-secure/hunter thresholds, lay_low/wait downtime action, CLI/Web surfaces, tests, ADR-017

impact_assessment.why: The living-grid clock and shift names are cosmetic: the same patrol, re-secure, and market behavior runs at 03:00 and 15:00, so time pressure cannot be played around. Players also lack a deliberate downtime action to recover CPU and pass a dangerous shift without spending trace.
impact_assessment.benefits: Each shift gets a legible tactical identity (quiet but costly nights, fast morning audits, hair-trigger afternoons, lagging evening handovers), and lay_low turns the clock into a resource: recover CPU and wait out the grid at the risk of patrols, hunters, and ambient events. Both CLI and Web expose the shift effect and downtime action.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: additive world_summary keys and optional keyword params on drift_market/plan_resecures/deploy_hunter; engine gains lay_low; no persisted schema change; dependency: none (stdlib only); concurrency: server serializes the action under the existing session lock; state: shift derives from world.minute, so existing saves need no migration and Morning defaults preserve current tests
impact_assessment.mitigation: Frozen ShiftProfile with explicit boundaries, optional defaults preserving callers, 1-3 turn cap and terminal-state guards on lay_low, failing-first unit/integration/API tests, aikit check after each milestone, and ADR-017 documenting the modifiers.

[1/6] Plan: living-grid deepening - combo tension on detected failures, alert escalation tiers with intrusion-footprint decay, shift-aware social engineering, market-coupled loot fencing, host-scaled daemon yields, lay-low trace cooling

impact_assessment.why: Balance audit found the combo streak is a risk-free ratchet (only lockout resets it), alert pressure decays faster than loud play accumulates it (hunters/re-secures are dead content in typical runs), lay_low is dominated by spoof/wipe_logs, and the living market/shift systems do not touch the social layer or loot income - undermining the simulation feel and the push-your-luck loop
impact_assessment.benefits: Restores loss aversion on combos, revives hunter/re-secure content mid-run, gives the clock tactical weight for social vectors, couples alert heat to loot value (self-balancing loud play), rewards deep daemon placement, and makes downtime a genuine third trace tool
impact_assessment.risks: contract: world_summary/ShiftProfile gain additive fields (old saves fine, from_dict defaults); dependency: CLI/server puzzle-exhaustion paths must call break_combo; concurrency: none (single-threaded engine); state: no new persisted fields, engine-transient tier cache only
impact_assessment.mitigation: Additive-only schema changes, failing-first tests per milestone, full unittest discover after each milestone, market pinned in exact-value economy tests, aikit check gate before commits
